tools.name: linkedin_forecast
tools.description: Sprites tool. LinkedIn's own forecast for up to 5 audiences, in seconds, from the user's connected LinkedIn Ads account: member count, cost per lead, cost per click and CTR over the next 30 days. Creates nothing. Use for "how many people can I reach on LinkedIn", "what would LinkedIn leads cost", sizing an ICP or comparing audiences before a campaign. Each audience is described with plain names; jobTitles and seniorities/jobFunctions are alternatives.

label.description: Short name for the audience, e.g. "Fleet COOs, 10k+ staff".

countries.description: Country names. At least one location is required.

jobFunctions.description: Job function names. Not with jobTitles.

objectiveType.description: Shapes the forecast. LEAD_GENERATION (default here) gives cost per lead.

dailyBudgetAmount.description: Daily budget the forecast assumes, in the ad account's currency. Defaults to 50.
